(Approved by the National Assembly of
Pakistan on the 2nd June, 1966, see Gaz. of P., 1966, Ext., pp. 359-361 (R).)
[2nd June, 1966]
An Ordinance further to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959
WHEREAS it is expedient further
to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, for the purposes hereinafter
appearing P.O. No. 18 of 1959 ;
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Basic Democra cies Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1966.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment of Article 3, P.O. No. 18 of 1959. In the Basic
Democracies Order, 1959, hereinafter referred to as the said Order, in Article
3, in clause (1), for sub-clause (24) the following shall be substituted,
namely P.O. No. 18 of 1959:-
"(24) `local council' means
a council constituted under this Order and includes a Union Council, a Town Committee
and a Union Committee ;"

[2nd June, 1966]
An Ordinance further to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959
WHEREAS it is expedient further
to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, for the purposes hereinafter
appearing P.O. No. 18 of 1959 ;
3. In the said Order, in
Article 15, for clause (3) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(3) The elected members of
a District Council shall be elected in the prescribed manner from amongst the
electors, not being officials,-
(a) in the case of the district
of Chittagong Hill tracts in East Pakistan and of a district within the Quetta
and Kalat Divisions in West Pakistan, by the members of the Union Councils and
Town Committees within the district ; and
(b) in any other case, by the
Chairman if the Union Councils and Town Committees within the district:
Provided that rules made for the
purpose of election under this clause may divide or provide for the division
of, a District into constituencies so as to ensure, so far as practicable and
consistently with administrative convenience, equitable representation to the
different parts of the district and also provide that a member or, in the case
of a multi-member constituency, members of the District Council for any such
constituency shall be elected from amongst the electors within that
constituency by the members or, as the case may be, the Chair men of the Union
Councils and Town Committees within such constituency."

Amendment of Article 16, P.O. No. 18 of 1959

THE BASIC DEMOCRACIES ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1966
ORDINANCE No. V of 1966
(Approved by the National Assembly of
Pakistan on the 2nd June, 1966, see Gaz. of P., 1966, Ext., pp. 359-361 (R).)
[2nd June, 1966]
An Ordinance further to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959
WHEREAS it is expedient further
to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, for the purposes hereinafter
appearing P.O. No. 18 of 1959 ;
4. Amendment of Article 16, P.O. No. 18 of 1959. In the said Order,
in Article 16, for clause (3) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(3) The elected members of
a Divisional Council from a district shall be elected in the prescribed manner
from amongst the electors, not being officials,-
(a) in the case of members under
sub-clause (b) of clause (1), by the elected members of the Municipal
Committees and Cantonment Boards within that district ; and
(b) in the case of members under
sub-clause (c) of clause (1), by the elected members of the District Council of
that district:
Provided that rules made for the
purpose of election under this clause may form, or provide for the formation
of, constituencies by arranging the Municipal Committees and Cantonment Boards
within a district into groups or, as the case may be, by dividing a district,
excluding the areas within the jurisdiction of a Municipal Committee or Canton ment
Board, so as to ensure, as far as practicable and consistently with
administrative convenience, equitable representation to the different parts of
the district and also provide that a member or, in the case of a multi-member
constituency, members of the Divisional Council for any such constituency shall
be elected from amongst the electors within that constituency. ".

Amendment of Article 22, P.O. No. 18 of 1959

WHEREAS it is expedient further

6. Saving. Any rule made under the said Order before the com mencement
of this Ordinance for the purpose of election to a District Council or a
Divisional Council shall be deemed to have been made under the said Order as
amended by this Ordinance, and any constituency formed, election held or other
action taken or thing done by, under or in pursuance of any such rule before
such commencement shall have and shall be deemed always to have had effect
accordingly.
